title: Whole-system stalk compositor data and strict finite subdata
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and a finite-field datum $D$ with algebraically closed field $k$ as in [def-trf-coefficient-conventions]. For any scheme $X$, restrict coefficient-system modules [def-coef-ringed-sequence-site] to the strict tower of completed-coefficient modules, apply the integral geometric stalk [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients] at $v:\operatorname{Spec}k\to X$ degreewise, and denote the resulting complex tower by $T_v$. Its Roos realization is $QH(T_v)$. Package finite pullback evaluation, strict germ, section and reparametrization maps; their derived realizations; and the normalized integral point-fibre comparison in TrfStalkCompositorTowerData. TrfStalkCompositorTowerCoherent records their finite unit and germ formulas, strict composition and reparametrization equations, localization-factor equations and the integral counit equations. TrfStalkCompositorQuotientCompatible is the identity of that integral comparison with the normalized quotient-stalk realization arrow for every simultaneous K-flat quotient presentation. These are exactly the interfaces formerly declared in the compositor realization module; no construction or condition is changed. The finite fields alone form TrfStrictStalkTowerData; their finite unit, germ, section, composition, identity and reparametrization equations form TrfStrictStalkTowerCoherent. The projection toStrict forgets the integral and derived fields.
